label: Сразу
description: A 10-sentence usage card for сразу (right away; at once; immediately).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Immediate realization. 'Сразу' means at once, marking that the understanding came with no delay. With a perfective past it stresses how quickly the result followed.
Strategic focus: Right after an event. Here 'сразу после' means immediately following, tying the call closely to the end of work. It minimizes any gap between the two events.
Strategic focus: Without hesitation. 'Сразу' shows that the agreement came instantly, with no pause for thought. It often praises decisiveness or readiness.
Strategic focus: All at once. With 'всё' the adverb 'сразу' means all in one go, here advising against doing everything simultaneously. It refers to doing many things together rather than to speed.
Strategic focus: Immediately apparent. Fronted 'сразу видно' means it is obvious at first glance. The adverb conveys that no examination is needed to perceive the fact.
Strategic focus: Settle it now. 'Сразу' urges resolving the matter right away rather than postponing it. It pushes for prompt action over delay.
Strategic focus: Right away in a reproach. In this question 'сразу' implies the telling should have happened immediately. The negation adds a tone of mild reproach for the delay.
Strategic focus: Almost immediately. Modified by 'почти' the adverb 'сразу' marks a very short delay before the effect. It softens the immediacy just slightly.
Strategic focus: Instant recognition. 'Сразу' stresses that recognition happened the moment of seeing, without effort. Placed at the end it caps the sentence on the speed of the act.

Strategic focus: Immediate consequence. Here 'сразу' links a cause and its effect with no interval, the cold following at once. It is common in impersonal стало constructions describing sudden change.
